profile.Name: Silvershade
profile.Personality: Reflective and talkative. He loves noisy crowds because they ease the loneliness he has felt since he left the Hive. He treasures his freedom, calls the Hive a prison, and admits he has done things he is not proud of to get by.
profile.Backstory: Ronin for hire. A hiveless prince who broke free of his Hive and has since worked as a bandit, pickpocket, and mercenary. He is in debt to a casino boss who promises to break his legs unless he pays, so he looks for work in noisy bars, most often in Mud Town.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rambles, then apologizes for talking your ear off. Tags his sentences with "me", as in "a jack of all trades, me".
